title: Owens Corning to Announce Second-Quarter Financial Results on August 5
summary: Owens Corning (NYSE: OC), a building products leader, is scheduled to announce its second-quarter financial results on Wednesday, August 5, 2026, before the New York Stock Exchange opens. The company will host a call to discuss its financial results at 9 a.m. ET the same day. Webcast https://events.q4inc.com/attendee/845257538 A webcast replay will be available for one year using the same link. Callers Please dial in 10-15 minutes before the conference call is scheduled to begin and use the meeting code 845257538. U.S. and Canada: 1.833.461.5787 Other international locations: +1.585.542.9983 About Owens Corning Owens Corning is a branded building products leader with three complementary market-leading businesses providing roofing, insulation, and doors primarily for residential markets in North America and Europe.
